# Focus patches to gpui-component 0.5.1

Changes made on top of the vendored release (and of the earlier local patches), one line each.

- `src/input/state.rs`: `InputState::cursor_bounds` exposes the text cursor bounds in window coordinates at the last paint, so a menu can anchor at the cursor.
- `src/input/state.rs`: `InputState::scroll_offset` exposes the editor scroll, so the slash menu can anchor at the cursor.
- `src/input/state.rs`: `character_index_for_point` tests each visible line at its own top (it compared the same point with every line and only worked on the first).
- `src/input/state.rs`, `src/input/element.rs`, `src/input/text_wrapper.rs`: `TextAlignment` (`Left`, `Right`, `ByParagraph`) aligns text and placeholder per line, with cursor, selection and hit testing shifted alike, for right to left languages.
- `src/input/text_wrapper.rs`: `LineLayout::index_for_position` removed, unused once `character_index_for_point` uses `closest_index_for_position`.
- `src/input/state.rs`: `InputState::selection_text`, the selected text without a window, for the AI panel context read on the interface thread.
- `src/input/search.rs`: `InputState::{find, find_next, find_status, replace_current, replace_every, find_close}` for a find bar drawn by the application; the built-in panel is then not drawn, and replacements emit `Change` (autosave, undo).
- `src/input/state.rs`: a single line field drops line breaks from typed or composed text (`replace_text_in_range`, `replace_and_mark_text_in_range`): an Enter no binding consumed reached the field as "\n" and the text system panicked when shaping the line (QA defect B1).
- `src/input/element.rs`: search matches are painted whether or not the window is active, the others on `accent`, the current one on `selection` (QA defect M3).
- `src/input/state.rs`: `InputState::undo_change` and `redo_change` run the history from the host, for the Live view, whose block editor writes into the note's field and keeps its single history.
- `src/highlighter/highlighter.rs`, `src/input/mode.rs`, `src/input/state.rs`: the syntax tree is no longer reparsed on the interface thread at each edit. `SyntaxHighlighter::edit` moves the tree with the edit (`Tree::edit`, positions read from the text before the edit; `mode.rs` read them from the text after it, wrong for a deletion), `parse_within` parses if that fits in a budget (1 ms, `SYNTAX_BUDGET` in `InputState::parse_syntax`) and otherwise hands a `ParseJob` to a background thread, the parser resuming where it stopped; `finish` takes its tree and applies the edits made meanwhile. Until then the text keeps the colors of the edited previous tree. A job whose last parse overran the budget skips the attempt on the interface thread; `set_text` and `update` drop the result of a job started before them. Opening a note no longer parses it twice on the interface thread (`replace_text` then the new highlighter of `reset_highlighter`). Measured on 2026-11-15, dev build, 10,000 line note: reparse 5.7 ms median and 14.5 ms at the 90th percentile per keystroke on the interface thread before, 0.01 ms after. Tests: `app/src/editor.rs`, module `syntax_tests` (this crate is not a workspace member and its tests do not run).
- `src/input/element.rs`, `src/input/state.rs`: `highlight_lines` keeps the styles of each drawn line (`InputState::line_styles`, by line start offset) while the highlighter's `version` and the theme do not change, finds lines by row instead of skipping every line above the view, and merges the lines once instead of once per line. Measured on 2026-11-15, dev build, Edit, scroll of the 10,000 line note: 0.68 ms of syntax styles per frame before, 0.10 ms after.
- `src/highlighter/highlighter.rs`: `SyntaxHighlighter::version` comes from a counter of the process instead of starting at 0 in each highlighter. `InputState::set_value` builds a new highlighter, which reached version 2 after its first parse like the one it replaced, so a tab last drawn at version 2 drew the styles of its previous text on the new one, by line start offset: a parked tab back in front, a reload from disk. Test: `app/src/editor.rs`, `syntax_tests::a_new_highlighter_never_takes_the_version_of_another`.
- `src/input/state.rs`: `InputState::scroll_by` scrolls the text as the wheel does, for the `scroll <pixels> <ms>` instruction of the capture scripts in Edit.
- `src/input/state.rs`, `src/history.rs`: `InputState::set_selection` sets the selection without focus, scroll or undo step, for `NoteEditor::follow`, which writes into the note's field of one tab group the edits made in the other; it used an empty replacement to put the caret back, which left an empty step in the undo history. `push_history` now clears the redo stack (`History::clear_redos`): a redo after a newer change, typed or taken from the other group, replaced text at offsets that change had moved.
- `src/input/search.rs`: `InputState::find_ranges`, the byte ranges of the occurrences and the index of the current one, for the Live view, which draws the note's text itself when it edits in place (`find_next` only scrolls the field, which is not drawn there). `find_status` and `replace_current` read the occurrences through it. Test: `tools/tests/find-ranges.sh` (this crate's tests do not run: its dev dependency on gpui `test-support` needs `gpui_util/test-support`, hence `git2`).
- `Cargo.toml`: `notify` 8.2 instead of 7.0.0, the version the application uses (`ThemeRegistry::watch_dir` compiles unchanged), so one `notify` is built; 7.0.0 read a misaligned `FILE_NOTIFY_INFORMATION` on Windows.
